```{r setup}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)
library(crosstalk)

db_path <- file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "futball.db")
con     <- dbConnect(SQLite(), db_path)
ts      <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT team, liga, szezon, quality, kpi, value FROM team_stats WHERE liga IN ('NB1','NB2')")
dbDisconnect(con)

quality_order_tbl <- c(
  "overallperformance", "attack", "chancecreation", "oppositionchancecreation",
  "attackingtransition", "defensivetransition", "defence",
  "styleofplayinattack", "styleofplayinchancecreation",
  "styleofplayinattackingtransition", "styleofplayindefence",
  "styleofplayindefensivetransition"
)

quality_labels <- c(
  "overallperformance"               = "Összteljesítmény",
  "attack"                           = "Támadás",
  "chancecreation"                   = "Gólhelyzet-teremtés",
  "oppositionchancecreation"         = "Ellenfél helyzet-teremtése",
  "attackingtransition"              = "Támadó átmenet",
  "defensivetransition"              = "Védelmi átmenet",
  "defence"                          = "Védekezés",
  "styleofplayinattack"              = "Stílus: támadás",
  "styleofplayinchancecreation"      = "Stílus: helyzet-teremtés",
  "styleofplayinattackingtransition" = "Stílus: tám. átmenet",
  "styleofplayindefence"             = "Stílus: védekezés",
  "styleofplayindefensivetransition" = "Stílus: véd. átmenet"
)

# KPI-sorrend: quality-csoport szerint, azon belül abc; duplikáltak egyszer szerepelnek
kpi_order_tbl <- ts |>
  mutate(quality = factor(quality, levels = quality_order_tbl)) |>
  arrange(quality, kpi) |>
  distinct(kpi) |>
  pull(kpi)

# Deduplicálás (egyes KPI-k több quality-csoportban is szerepelnek) — a szezont
# NEM dedupláljuk el, különben a `team_stats` tábla tobb szezonja (2022-23 .. jelen)
# összemosódna egyetlen (ábécé szerint elsőként feldolgozott fájlból származó)
# szezonra. Csapat-szezononként egy sor marad a táblázatban, a szezon külön szűrhető.
ts_dedup <- ts |> distinct(team, liga, szezon, kpi, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Percentilis: kpi-nkent ES szezononkent kulon (nem all a kulonbozo szezonok
# ertekei ossze, azok nem osszehasonlithatoak egymassal)
ts_pct <- ts_dedup |>
  group_by(kpi, szezon) |>
  mutate(pct = rank(value, ties.method = "average") / n()) |>
  ungroup()

wide <- ts_pct |>
  select(team, liga, szezon, kpi, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = kpi, values_from = value) |>
  select(team, liga, szezon, all_of(kpi_order_tbl)) |>
  arrange(liga, team, desc(szezon))

wide_pct <- ts_pct |>
  select(team, liga, szezon, kpi, pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = kpi, values_from = pct, names_prefix = "pct__") |>
  select(team, liga, szezon, all_of(paste0("pct__", kpi_order_tbl))) |>
  arrange(liga, team, desc(szezon))

tbl    <- wide |> left_join(wide_pct, by = c("team", "liga", "szezon"))
sd_tbl <- SharedData$new(tbl)

bg_colors <- c(
  "#F9C8C5","#FBD5C0","#FCE5C0","#FEF2D0","#FEFEE8",
  "#F0F9D5","#DBEFBD","#C2E2BB","#A5D5A8","#87C893"
)
breaks <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)

n_fixed   <- 3L
n_stat    <- length(kpi_order_tbl)
stat_end  <- n_fixed + n_stat - 1L
pct_start <- n_fixed + n_stat
pct_end   <- n_fixed + 2L * n_stat - 1L

# quality-csoportok fejléce (dedup utáni KPI-k alapján)
quality_group_cols <- ts |>
  mutate(quality = factor(quality, levels = quality_order_tbl)) |>
  arrange(quality, kpi) |>
  distinct(kpi, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(quality, kpi)

col_groups_tbl <- quality_group_cols |>
  group_by(quality) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(label = quality_labels[quality])

group_bg <- c(
  overallperformance               = "#EFF6FF",
  attack                           = "#DBEAFE",
  chancecreation                   = "#DBEAFE",
  oppositionchancecreation         = "#FEF2F2",
  attackingtransition              = "#F0FDF4",
  defensivetransition              = "#F0FDF4",
  defence                          = "#FEF2F2",
  styleofplayinattack              = "#FFFBEB",
  styleofplayinchancecreation      = "#FFFBEB",
  styleofplayinattackingtransition = "#F0FDF4",
  styleofplayindefence             = "#FFF7ED",
  styleofplayindefensivetransition = "#FFF7ED"
)
group_fg <- c(
  overallperformance               = "#1E40AF",
  attack                           = "#1D4ED8",
  chancecreation                   = "#1D4ED8",
  oppositionchancecreation         = "#B91C1C",
  attackingtransition              = "#15803D",
  defensivetransition              = "#15803D",
  defence                          = "#B91C1C",
  styleofplayinattack              = "#B45309",
  styleofplayinchancecreation      = "#B45309",
  styleofplayinattackingtransition = "#166534",
  styleofplayindefence             = "#C2410C",
  styleofplayindefensivetransition = "#C2410C"
)
```

```{r render}
row1_ths <- c(
  list(
    tags$th(rowspan = "2", "Csapat"),
    tags$th(rowspan = "2", "Liga"),
    tags$th(rowspan = "2", "Szezon")
  ),
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(col_groups_tbl)), function(i) {
    q <- col_groups_tbl$quality[i]
    tags$th(
      colspan = as.character(col_groups_tbl$n[i]),
      style   = paste0(
        "text-align:center;background:", group_bg[q],
        ";color:", group_fg[q],
        ";font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.04em;"
      ),
      toupper(col_groups_tbl$label[i])
    )
  }),
  lapply(paste0("pct__", kpi_order_tbl), function(p)
    tags$th(rowspan = "2", style = "display:none;", p))
)

row2_ths <- lapply(kpi_order_tbl, function(k)
  tags$th(style = "font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;", k))

cat_sketch <- tags$table(
  class = "display",
  tags$thead(
    do.call(tags$tr, row1_ths),
    do.call(tags$tr, row2_ths)
  )
)

dt_base <- DT::datatable(
  sd_tbl,
  container  = cat_sketch,
  rownames   = FALSE,
  escape     = FALSE,
  selection  = "none",
  options    = list(
    dom        = "ft",
    pageLength = 500,
    ordering   = TRUE,
    scrollX    = TRUE,
    language   = list(search = "Keresés:"),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(visible    = FALSE,      targets = seq(pct_start, pct_end)),
      list(className = "dt-center", targets = seq(1L, stat_end)),
      list(className = "dt-left",   targets = 0L),
      list(render = DT::JS(
        "function(data, type, row) {",
        "  if(type === 'display' && data !== null && data !== undefined)",
        "    return parseFloat(data).toFixed(2);",
        "  return data;",
        "}"
      ), targets = seq(n_fixed, stat_end))
    )
  )
)

dt_styled <- Reduce(function(d, kpi_name) {
  d |> formatStyle(
    columns         = kpi_name,
    valueColumns    = paste0("pct__", kpi_name),
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(breaks, bg_colors)
  )
}, kpi_order_tbl, dt_base)

tagList(
  tags$div(
    style = "margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;",
    filter_select("liga_sel", "Liga", sd_tbl, ~liga, multiple = TRUE),
    filter_select("szezon_sel", "Szezon", sd_tbl, ~szezon, multiple = TRUE)
  ),
  dt_styled,
  tags$p(
    style = "font-size:11px;color:#9CA3AF;margin-top:8px;font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;",
    "Percentilis: az adott KPI-n és szezonon belül, az összes csapat alapján (szezononként külön számolva)."
  )
)
```
